title: Titanium Surgical Retractor Blade
alloyReason: Grade 9 Ti-3Al-2.5V (UNS R56320) is specified for this surgical instruments application needing intermediate strength between CP and Ti-6Al-4V with superior cold formability. Its 620 MPa tensile with 20% elongation provides 30% weight reduction vs steel. This rationale is driven by lightweight surgical retractor blade and fat life requirements.
process: CNC swiss turning for surgical instruments geometry
Ultrasonic clean Class 10k with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for lightweight surgical retractor application
inspection: Mech test ASTM per std (lightweight surgical verified)
commonFailures: Fatigue fracture at thread root under cyclic bending - resolved by thread rolling (not cutting) for compressive stress — critical for lightweight surgical retractor performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Surgical Retractor Blade suitable for Lightweight surgical retractor blade?
faq.a: Titanium Surgical Retractor Blade uses Grade 9 Ti-3Al-2.5V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address surgical instruments operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Surgical Retractor Blade?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Surgical Retractor Blade is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for lightweight surgical retractor requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Surgical Retractor Blade require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. lightweight surgical retractor components require Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for lightweight surgical retractor application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Surgical Retractor Blade shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Surgical Retractor Blade includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet lightweight surgical retractor specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.
